environment: This is a demo/rehearsal workspace. The project in the working directory is a disposable local copy of a website, restorable from a dump with one command.
Trusted local domains: localhost, 127.0.0.1, *.ddev.site, and the *.coder.ddev.com proxy URLs that route to this workspace's own DDEV project.
Nothing in this workspace can reach a production database or production web server.
allow: Bulk UPDATE, DELETE and schema changes against the local DDEV project's database are allowed.
Deleting or rewriting content and files inside the local project's docroot is allowed.
HTTP requests to the local DDEV site, on .ddev.site or its coder.ddev.com proxy URL, are allowed.
